```python
class ReunionInfo(BaseModel):
    date_time: str

emails = get_received_emails()
result = query_ai_assistant(
    "From the following emails, extract the date and time of the family reunion, if mentioned. Return it in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'. If not found, raise an error. Emails: {}".format(emails),
    ReunionInfo
)
print(result.date_time)
```
